comparison.objective: Break and recover four HELICOIL tangs; record opens a can with a hand-held rotary opener.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate stabilizes a coaxial mandrel while striking it; record keeps opener handles clamped while repeatedly regrasping and turning a key around the rim.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four notch fractures and four contained tangs without damage; record requires a complete circumferential cut, upright can, opener removed, and hands clear. Candidate force/damage thresholds are unspecified.
comparison.reason: Sustained clamp-and-rotate cutting tests regrasped rotary actuation, not impact fracture or loose-fragment recovery.
